answers: Cron runs /usr/local/sbin/backup-app-db, which uses docker exec to run pg_dump with --format=custom.
The script runs find with -mtime +6 -delete on app_*.dump files, deleting backups at least seven full 24-hour periods old.
In a separate test container (app-db-restore-test), using postgres:17 with no network, not production.
